as_of_content:
[[File:Star Saber portrait.png|thumb]] The '''Star Saber''' is a rare Relic.
==Description==
''A blade of untold power capable of pulverizing entire planets with ease.''

==Relic Boost==
*+5% Story XP
*v6.3: Increases Gold +10%, Attack +3%, and HP +3% in Story and Special Missions.
==Obtainment==
*Upon launch of the game, the Star Saber was available in the Raid Store for a limited time for ''2,000,000 ''Raid Chips.
*v6.3: Available for 20 Relic Tickets in the Raid Store from August to September.
